atomic_tests.name: Device Driver Discovery
atomic_tests.description:
Displays a list of installed device drivers on the local computer and their properties. Threat actors use this command to enumerate the existing drivers on the computer. 
Parameters: 
/v /fo list - Displays verbose output in a list format - the /v parameter is not valid for signed drivers
/si /fo list - Provides information about signed drivers and outputs it in a list format

atomic_tests.name: Device Driver Discovery (Linux)
atomic_tests.description: Displays a list of loaded kernel modules on a Linux system, which is used to enumerate drivers.

atomic_tests.name: Enumerate Kernel Driver Files (Linux)
atomic_tests.description: Finds and lists all kernel driver files on a Linux system in order to provide a broader view of available drivers, not just loaded ones.

atomic_tests.name: List loaded kernel extensions (macOS)
atomic_tests.description: Displays a list of loaded kernel extensions (kexts) on a macOS system.

atomic_tests.name: Find Kernel Extensions (macOS)
atomic_tests.description: Searches for kernel extension (kext) files on a macOS system.
